title: Detecting Incorrect LLM Explanations for Automated Program Repair
title_zh: 检测大语言模型生成的不正确自动程序修复解释

paragraphs.en: 提出基于蜕变测试的MetaReJ方法，自动检测大语言模型生成的不正确程序修复解释，性能大幅提升。 LLM-generated explanations help developers understand automated program repair (APR) rationale and assess patch quality. Incorrect explanations can mislead developers about a repair's reliability, making their detection important. However, manually inspecting the growing volume of generated repairs is impractical, motivating automated detection. Existing methods mainly target incorrect answers from general question-answering LLMs, often by sampling multiple responses and detecting contradictions. Applied to APR, they face two limitations: (1) they may depend on external verifiers that are unavailable or lack APR-specific reasoning; and (2) sampling strategies such as paraphrasing or re-prompting the same input often yield superficial, redundant responses that repeat the original error rather than expose it. We propose MetaReJ, the first method designed to detect incorrect APR explanations using metamorphic testing. Inspired by debate and viva examinations, MetaReJ challenges explanations through an argumentative strategy without requiring external verifiers. It applies novel metamorphic relations (MRs) to recursively question the LLM under equivalent and non-equivalent repair scenarios and detect contradictions. To obtain diverse samples, MetaReJ transforms the buggy program into variants that preserve or alter the underlying bug, then asks the LLM how to repair each variant. Contradictions among responses are encoded as MR violations, which indicate that the original explanation is incorrect. We evaluate MetaReJ on a manually labelled dataset of 1,756 explanations from multiple LLM-based APR systems. MetaReJ achieves an MCC of up to 0.43, outperforming prior methods by up to 333.3% in MCC.
paragraphs.zh: 提出基于蜕变测试的MetaReJ方法，自动检测大语言模型生成的不正确程序修复解释，性能大幅提升。大语言模型生成的解释能帮助开发者理解自动程序修复（APR）的原理并评估补丁质量。 不正确的解释可能会误导开发者对修复可靠性的判断，因此检测这类解释十分重要。 然而，人工检查日益增长的修复数量并不现实，这促使了对自动化检测的需求。 现有方法主要针对通用问答大语言模型生成的不正确答案，通常通过采样多个回复并检测其中的矛盾来实现。 将这些方法应用于APR时存在两个局限：（1）它们可能依赖不可用的外部验证器，或缺乏针对APR的推理能力；（2）诸如改写或对同一输入重新提示等采样策略，往往产生肤浅且冗余的回复，只是重复原始错误而非暴露它。 我们提出MetaReJ，这是首个使用蜕变测试来检测不正确APR解释的方法。 受辩论和口试答辩的启发，MetaReJ通过论证策略对解释进行质疑，而无需外部验证器。 它应用新颖的蜕变关系（MR），在等价和非等价修复场景下递归地询问大语言模型，并检测其中的矛盾。 为获取多样化的样本，MetaReJ将有缺陷的程序转换为保留或改变底层缺陷的变体，然后询问大语言模型如何修复每个变体。 回复之间的矛盾被编码为MR违反，这表明原始解释是不正确的。 我们在一个人工标注的数据集上评估MetaReJ，该数据集包含来自多个基于大语言模型的APR系统的1,756条解释。 MetaReJ的MCC最高达到0.43，在MCC上比先前方法最高提升333.3%。
